proof_sketch: The missing __syncthreads() in the mean reduction loop causes race conditions where threads 0-63 may read stale values from threads 64-127 before stride-128 reduction completes. With uniform random data, partial sum errors may average out. With highly asymmetric data where threads 128-255 hold massive values and threads 0-127 hold zeros, any race-induced data loss produces catastrophic mean error that propagates to output.
